description: Risk R-B first, because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is TransactionAddController, and this program adds nothing - it VIEWS. Four independent sources say so: app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 'Function    : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file', README.md:314 '| CT01 | COTRN01 | COTRN01C | Transaction View |', app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 'CardDemo - Transaction View' and the on-screen literal INITIAL='View Transaction' at POS=(4,30) - app/bms/COTRN01.bms:78-79. The mapset corroborates it structurally: 56 DFHMDF entries, 21 named, and exactly ONE UNPROT - TRNIDIN at :85, ATTRB=(FSET,IC,NORM,UNPROT) COLOR=GREEN HILIGHT=UNDERLINE LENGTH=16 POS=(6,21) - so one input-capable field faces twenty output-only ones, which is a lookup-then-display screen and not a data-entry screen. Rule R1 resolves it - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so it is documented here and never silently corrected. No arm of this case asserts an insert, expectedWrites is empty, and the half of the swap that genuinely adds a transaction lives in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: the empty-key rejection on the RE-ENTRY path, reached BEFORE any file I/O. EIBCALEN is 218, so :94 takes its else arm and :98 copies the passed area over CARDDEMO-COMMAREA; CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives at 1, so CDEMO-PGM-REENTER already holds at :99 and control takes the ELSE at :110-111 rather than the first-entry arm - which is why the echoed context is still 1 and why the :100 SET and the :101 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN1AO never run on this path. :111 performs RECEIVE-TRNVIEW-SCREEN (:230-238, RECEIVE MAP('COTRN1A') MAPSET('COTRN01') INTO(COTRN1AI)), then the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at :112 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER, and performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY. There the EVALUATE TRUE at :146 takes its first arm too: WS-ERR-FLG becomes 'Y', 'Tran ID can NOT be empty...' goes to WS-MESSAGE, -1 goes to TRNIDINL and the screen is sent ONCE at :152. Both guards then fail closed - :158 IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON is false, so the thirteen-field blanking of :159-171, the MOVE TRNIDINI TO TRAN-ID of :172 and READ-TRANSACT-FILE are ALL skipped, and :176 is false too, so the thirteen record-to-screen moves and the second send at :191 are skipped as well. THE KEYED READ AT :269-278 NEVER EXECUTES, which is why TRANSACT is seeded with nothing: a case that seeded rows it never touches would suggest it had, and no file-status or response-code outcome is asserted anywhere here because there is no I/O to report one for. The task ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) of :136-139, so exactly one send, no write, no read. WHICH HALF OF :147 THIS CASE TAKES, and why that is not the other one: the condition is 'WHEN TRNIDINI OF COTRN1AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES', which is TWO tests, and SPACES and LOW-VALUES are different bytes - x'40' or x'20' against x'00'. case05 pins the SPACES half. This case pins the LOW-VALUES half, so TRNIDINI arrives as sixteen genuine U+0000 bytes: that is precisely the state a 3270 sends for a field the operator never typed into, and a translation that kept only the spaces test would accept it. Pinning SPACES here as well would have made this fixture byte-identical to case05 and left the OR LOW-VALUES test with no pin at all, so the two halves are pinned by the two cases and the pair is held constant in every other respect - the same AID, the same commarea and the same value typed into TDESCI - so that the sixteen bytes of TRNIDIN are the only difference between them. THE HIGHLIGHT, and why an empty attribute map is the assertion rather than an omission: gate G38 asks that field highlighting apply only in REENTER state, and COTRN01C satisfies it in the strongest available form by applying none in EITHER state. It does not copy CSSETATY - its eight COPY statements at :52-72 are COCOM01Y, COTRN01, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - and it declares no FLG-<field>-NOT-OK or FLG-<field>-BLANK pair for a resolver to act on, so no DFHRED reaches TRNIDINC and no '*' reaches TRNIDINO on this rejecting path or on any other. The decision is still resolved through the same FieldAttributeSetter the highlighting screens use and comes back untouched, which is why 'attributes' is present and empty rather than absent. The whole of this program's error signalling is the message line plus MOVE -1 TO TRNIDINL, and -1 in an xxxL item is the CURSOR request, not a colour: it is reported as cursorField, which AAP section 0.3.9 requires, because an xxxL item is validation and highlight metadata and never a payload member. THE TWENTY-ONE PINNED FIELDS. Six are the header POPULATE-HEADER-INFO rebuilds at :245-262: TITLE01O is CCDA-TITLE01 and TITLE02O is CCDA-TITLE02, both PIC X(40) with their leading and trailing spaces inside the field, and TITLE02O takes the ACTIVE app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy:22 value rather than the commented-out :21 alternative; TRNNAMEO is WS-TRANID 'CT01' at PIC X(04) and PGMNAMEO is WS-PGMNAME 'COTRN01C' at PIC X(08), both from :36-37; CURDATEO and CURTIMEO are PINNED (practice B7) to the instant the source's own footer at :329 carries, 2022-07-19 23:12:34, because MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :245 is otherwise non-deterministic. One is ERRMSGO. The remaining fourteen are the received map itself: 01 COTRN1AO REDEFINES COTRN1AI makes the xxxI and xxxO views one buffer, so what RECEIVE left standing is what the SEND carries. TRNIDINO is therefore the sixteen nulls this case supplied and TDESCO echoes 'TYPED BY THE OPERATOR' padded to its declared 60 - the operator's typing survives BECAUSE the blanking at :159-171 was skipped, which is the observable difference between this rejection and the not-found rejection of case07, where the same value comes back blank. The other twelve detail items are spaces at their declared widths, not nulls: an xxxI item this case does not name arrives absent and is reshaped to the blank field a PIC X receiver holds, and unlike the first-entry cases nothing here moved LOW-VALUES over the output map. THE TWO MESSAGE CHANNELS are declared separately at their own widths because :217 moves WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78) and COBOL loses the two rightmost bytes. Both images are the same 27-character literal - note 'Tran' and not 'Transaction', the upper-case NOT and the three trailing dots - space-filled to 80 and to 78 respectively, so the truncation is observable rather than hidden inside one channel. ERRMSGO is pinned at 78, never 80. There is no DISPLAY line: the program's only DISPLAY is at :290, inside the WHEN OTHER arm of the read, which this path never reaches. STATELESSNESS (rule R6, gate G37): the whole 218-byte area travels in the payload and nothing is held server-side. app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy is 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160 bytes and the CDEMO-CT01-INFO extension at :53-61 is 16 + 16 + 8 + 1 + 1 + 16 = 58, which is 218 in all; the extension is carried as its own field rather than folded into the 160-byte context all seventeen controllers share, and all 22 fields are pinned so none is left unchecked. A field the passed area does not name keeps what its picture gives it - spaces for PIC X, zeros for PIC 9 - so CDEMO-CT01-NEXT-PAGE-FLG is blank rather than the 'N' of its VALUE clause at :57, because :98 overwrote WORKING-STORAGE with the caller's bytes. nextProgram carries COTRN01C because the task ends at EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) and app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD binds TRANSACTION(CT01) to PROGRAM(COTRN01C), so the operator's next input returns to this same program; nextMapset and nextMap carry the COTRN01 and COTRN1A the SEND at :219-225 names; and termination is RETURN_TRANSID rather than XCTL. There is no EXEC CICS XCTL on this path at all, so gate G40 is NOT discharged here and no transfer target is invented. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY - 21 xxxI payload items summing to 416, so the group is 12 + 21 x 7 + 416 = 575 bytes) and the transaction definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G30 (both ordered EVALUATEs honoured in source order - EIBAID at :112 takes the first of its five arms and the figurative-constant test at :146 the first of its two), G37, G38 and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this path has none of them: G19, G21 and G23 (no record is seeded, read or written, so this case pins no record width), G32 (zero GO TO), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination), G40 (no XCTL), G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC) and G47 (the keyed-read call site is never reached, so no I/O outcome is fabricated for it).
